question: What Are the Main Instrumentation and Control Standards?
body_html:
Instrumentation and control standards are published documents that give engineers a common technical language for design, installation, control systems and safety. Each applies only within its own scope:

StandardScope
ISA-5.1Instrument symbols and identification
IEC 60529IP code for enclosures
IEC 60534Industrial process control valves
IEC 61131-3PLC programming languages
IEC 60079Explosive atmospheres, hazardous areas
IEC 61511Safety instrumented systems, process industry
